instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Structure the multi-page navigation cleanly with top sticky glassmorphism header featuring the GWH logo, page links (Home, Founder & Story, Services, AI & WhatsApp Automation, Frameworks & Diagrams, Industries, FAQ, Contact), and a high-contrast 'Book Strategy Call' CTA button.
2. Implement Lenis or smooth scroll logic along with Framer Motion for line-by-line text reveals and element fade-ups throughout the pages.
3. Build an interactive HTML5 Canvas or Three.js node network background in the hero section that reacts subtly to mouse movement, signaling automation nodes.

4. Ensure all 13 'We Do / You Do' swimlane charts, the 6-stage + decision customer journey flowchart, the 5-step process timeline, 6-step loops, 5-lenses funnel, and 2x2 matrix are rendered as beautiful, animated dark-mode SVG diagrams with interactive tooltips/drawers.
5. Build an interactive Consulting ROI Calculator where visitors adjust monthly revenue, staff hours, and lead volume to see estimated time/money saved via GWH automation.

6. Include a functional contact form that stores submissions to localStorage (simulating a private admin inbox drawer accessible via hidden / admin trigger) and provides direct WhatsApp link pre-filled with consulting enquiry.
7. Attach data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, nav items, form fields, diagram toggles, sliders, tabs).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.data_testid_rule: Every button, link, tab, input, dialog, card, and interactive diagram node MUST have a descriptive kebab-case data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.hover_contrast: Ensure text remains highly readable on hover. Always explicitly set hover:text-white or hover:text-emerald-300 when background shifts.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Header backdrop filter must use bg-[#070B08]/85 backdrop-blur-md, never 100% pure transparent text floating without scrim.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.component_reuse: Utilize pre-built shadcn components (Tabs, Accordion, Dialog, Sheet, Select, Input, Button, Card, Badge) in src/components/ui/ customized with dark emerald styling.
